#### International Order Cancellation

#### International Order Cancellation

Order Status
: Confirmed, Warehouse Processed or Packed
- If the order was not shipped, then cancel it without sending an Email, If the order was Packed then create a NDR ticket and once the QC {Quality Check} is done the Refund team will complete the refund process.

Order Status: Shipped but Not yet received by the shipping company

Step 1
1. Choose the order you want to track
2. Click on Track

![image](/web/image/1215-ad5d627e/1.png)
Step 2

2. Click on **AWB No**.

**Note**: You can see the order status from DSP Status.

![image](/web/image/1214-346a2df1/2.png)
Step 3
1. Create a NDR Ticket
2. Send an Email

Jordan
Address Requirement
- City name.
- Street No. or name.
- Region.
- House number.
- Consignee Number.

For order confirmation Customer's **1st** **& 2nd** is required.

ID number is required for high value orders only ( **+199** JOD).

Number
- Country code key: (00) 962
- Phone number digits: Number **7******followed by **8**digits, Total **9** Digits.

Currency
- JOD:
Jordanian dinar, Equals: **100**
[qirsh](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Qirsh)

ID No.
- ID number include **11**digits, starts with a **letter**and **10**numbers and it called in Jordan the national number.

Shipping Charges
- Prepaid: **18**JOD ​{Jordanian Dinar​}.

Note:  The maximum order limit is **1000**JOD.

Import Fees
- Jordan has two VAT/TAX percentage.
- **10%** if the order was less than **200**JOD.
- **46%** if the order was above **200** JOD.

Max Cart Value
- **980**JOD.

Max Products Limit Per Cart
- **30**Different Product.
- **12**Of The Same Product.

title: Email Etiquette
content:
# Email Etiquette

# 10 Rules of Email Etiquette ✉️

Built for daily work emails. Easy rules. Real examples. Minimal cringe.
Formatting Rule (non-negotiable):
All email text must be
Calibri
, size
11
.
Rule 1
Subject line = the headline
Make it searchable and specific. Future-you will thank present-you.

Example

❌ Not great
Subject: Update

✅ Better
Subject: Action Required: Confirm QC Status for Order #12345

Rule 2
Start with a clear purpose (first 2 lines)
Don’t warm up like a TED Talk. Say what you need early.

Example

❌ Not great
Hope you are well.
Just wanted to check regarding something related to the order…

✅ Better
I’m reaching out to confirm whether Order #12345 can be cancelled before pickup.
Please confirm by 2:00 PM so we can proceed with NDR.

Rule 3
One email = one main topic
If the email has “Also…” five times, it’s five emails wearing a trench coat.

Example

✅ Tip
If you must include a second topic, add a tiny section:
1) Main request
2) Secondary (optional)

Rule 4
Use bullet points for actions + deadlines
Bullets reduce back-and-forth and “I missed that line” incidents.

Example

✅ Better
Kindly confirm:
• Can we cancel shipment before pickup? (Yes/No)
• If yes, please confirm cancellation by 3:00 PM
• We will create NDR immediately after confirmation

Rule 5
CC with intention (not as a threat 😄)
CC only people who need visibility or action. Don’t CC the universe.

Example

✅ Better
CC: Warehouse Team (for cancellation action), Shipping Company (for visibility)

Rule 6
Be polite, not fluffy
Professional ≠ long. Respect time, keep warmth.

Example

❌ Not great
Kindly kindly kindly if possible please check and revert back asap.

✅ Better
Please confirm by 2:00 PM so we can proceed today. Thank you.

Rule 7
Write for the reader’s next step
Tell them exactly what you want them to do (reply / approve / confirm / attach).

Example

✅ Better
Action needed: Reply with “Approved” or “Not Approved” to cancel the shipment.

Rule 8
Avoid ALL CAPS and “??!!”
ALL CAPS reads like shouting. Multiple punctuation reads like panic.

Example

❌ Not great
PLEASE CONFIRM ASAP??!!

✅ Better
Please confirm at your earliest convenience (today, if possible).

Rule 9
Attachments: name them and reference them
“See attached” is okay. “See attached… what?” is not.

Example

✅ Better
Attached: Return_Request_Order12345.pdf
Please review Section 2 (reason + QC status) and confirm cancellation.

Rule 10
Close with clarity + signature
End with the next step and a clean sign-off.

Example

✅ Better
Thank you in advance.
Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Department / Team]

Quick reminder:
Keep all outgoing email text in
Calibri
size
11
.
        Consistency = professionalism.

## Exchange Process

#### The exchange process is used when a customer requests to exchange a product they have ordered and received

#### 01

## For International Exchange

Change In Mind

Step 2
After creating the exchange order the agent will unhold the order and then hold it again, so it doesn't auto confirm.

Step 3

Step 4
Once the pickup is confirmed by the shipping company via the carrier's portal / Email, then the exchange order will be confirmed.

![image](/web/image/2925-48edbce1/eX%202.webp)

## 07

![image](/web/image/1103-2c1596df/12.png)

### Important Exchange Q&A's

Here are some common questions and answers related to Exchange.

When should I request a product picture for an exchange?
- **Change of mind exchanges:** A product photo is **mandatory for all customers** to confirm the item is in **original condition**. The photo must be **uploaded in the exchange ticket**.
- **VIP customers (Diamond / Gold / Silver):** **No product photo is required.**
- **All other customer categories:** A product photo **is required** and must be attached to the ticket.

Can a customer exchange an item for another product with a different price?
- The exchange item must be **the same price or lower** than the original item.
- If the new item is **lower in price**, the difference is added to the customer’s **store credit**.

**If the customer wants a higher-priced item:**

- We do **not** process an exchange to a higher value item.
- Instead, advise the customer to **return the item** and we will **refund the amount to store credit within 48 hours** after we receive the product — then they can **place a new order** for the higher-priced item.

**Note:** Always confirm the customer’s **email is active** before refunding any amount to store credit.

Can international customers return or exchange an item if they changed their mind?
- **Yes.** International customers are eligible for **returns and exchanges** in case of **change of mind**.
- **Return shipping cost** will be covered by **Boutiqaat**.

If an international customer receives a damaged, defective, or wrong item, can they exchange it?
- **Yes.** International customers are eligible for an exchange if the reason is **change of mind, damaged, defective, wrong product, used**, or **any other reason**.

Are international customers who paid using Tabby or Tamara eligible for returns and exchanges?
- **Yes.** Customers who paid using **Tabby** or **Tamara** are eligible for **returns and exchanges**, including cases of **damaged/defective/wrong items**.

title: Reschedule / Denied Tickets
content:
#### Reschedule / Denied Tickets

#### Reschedule Without Date Ticket

What is Reschedule Without Date ?
- **Reschedule Without Date**: Means when the driver tried to contact the customer to deliver their order the customer didn't answer the call from the driver.

What will happen to the order ?
- The order will be returned to logistics a reschedule without date will be created, then the contact center will call the customer to reschedule the order delivery date.

When will the order be delivered again ?
- Delivery will be within 48 working hours after confirming the Reschedule date with the customer and rescheduling the delivery.

How can I Reschedule the order delivery ?
Step 1
- Choose the order then click on **Order Detail**.

![image](/web/image/1145-695a0c09/1.png)
Step 2
1. Click on **Ticket Details**.
2. Click on **Ticket ID**.

![image](/web/image/1146-545fb118/2.png)
Step 3
- Choose the Reschedule date {**Next Day**}.

![image](/web/image/1147-e2b3b12e/3.png)
Step 4
- Scroll Down to comments:

1. Type
**Reschedule**in the comments section.
2. Assign to: Logistics
3. Outbound
4. Sarafaraz Zafar
5. Click on **Assign**and the ticket will be assigned to Logistics for delivery.

![image](/web/image/1148-cbe58aa7/4.png)
Call Status

#### Reschedule With Date Ticket

What is Reschedule With Date ?
**Reschedule With Date:** Means when the driver called the customer for delivery, the customer answered the driver and informed him he can't receive the order now.

What will happen to the order ?
The order will be returned to logistics and a Reschedule With Date ticket will be created and the order will be delivered again within 48 hours.

Do I have to do anything with the Reschedule with date ticket ?

Compensation Amounts
Compensation for the following reasons is **3** K.D on all orders amount:​

- Received item damaged/defective

Compensation for Expired items is **5** K.D on all orders amount.

Compensation for Price Issues is **2** K.D on all orders amount.

The rest of the compensations amounts will be **2.5** K.D on all orders amount.

Important Q&A's Related to Expired or nearly Expired products

What is the accepted product validity ?

title: Gift Card
content:
## Gift Card

#### Gift Cards Are prepaid cards that contain a specific amount of money that can be used to make purchases. Customers can purchase Boutiqaat’s Gift Cards online, the same way a regular product is purchased. A gifted card can be redeemed by the receiver.

#### Sending & Redeeming Gift Cards

how to send a gift card ?
**Follow these simple steps to send a Gift card:**

1. Click on ‘**Account’**, located at the bottom right-hand corner of Boutiqaat application.
2. Click on **‘Gift Card’**.
3. Click on **‘Send eGift Card’**.
4. Click On **’View’**.
5. Choose the amount you wish from the provided or click on **‘Enter Amount’**to send a custom amount.
6. Enter the Recipient’s Name and Phone Number.
7. Click on **‘Buy Now’**.

How to redeem a gift card ?
**Follow these simple steps to redeem a Gift card Voucher:**

1. Click on ‘**Account’**, located at the bottom right-hand corner of Boutiqaat application.
2. Click on **‘Gift Card’.**
3. Click on**‘Redeem eGift Card’.**
4. Enter your eGift Card Code.
5. Click on **‘Apply to Your Boutiqaat Credit’.**
6. The amount will reflect on your Boutiqaat Credit.

#### Gift Card Q&A's

Here are some Questions and and answers related to Gift Cards.

Can a gift card order be cancelled after purchase?​
**No.** Gift card orders **cannot be cancelled**.

Once a customer purchases a gift card, the gift card code is sent to the recipient via **SMS within 5 minutes**.

Can KSA customers send or receive gift cards internationally?​
Customers registered with a **KSA account** can **only send and receive gift cards within KSA**.

They cannot send or receive gift cards to/from other countries.

Which countries can exchange gift cards with each other (non-KSA accounts -
GCC, Iraq, Jordan
)?
- Customers registered in Kuwait, Bahrain, UAE, Oman, Qatar and Iraq can send and receive gift cards to and from each other.

What information is required to send a gift card to the correct recipient?​
- The recipient **Name** and **Phone Number** must be **accurate**.
- The sender may add an optional **message**, which will appear in the gift card SMS sent to the recipient.

What should I do if the customer received a missing or incorrect gift card code?​
- Submit a ticket through the **Helpdesk “[Gift Card Issues](/gift-card-issues)” link**.
- After IT resolves the issue, the correct code will be sent to the customer via **email**.

Do gift cards expire?​
- **eGift card codes expire 1 year** from the purchase date.
- **Unused codes** are **not refunded or compensated** after expiry.
- **Redeemed gift cards do not expire.**

What if the customer loses their gift card code?​
- Boutiqaat is **not responsible** for lost gift cards and does **not replace** them.

Where does the gift card balance go after redemption?​
- Once redeemed, the gift card balance is added to the customer’s Boutiqaat Credit (Store Credit – SC).

Understanding why orders are placed on hold or cancelled,

Blacklisted Category
COD Orders
Process

- If there is no answer, the order will be cancelled.

Risky Category
COD Orders
Process
- Customer called once to pay (CRM Assigned).
- If no answer, order is put on HOLD.
- While on hold:

                  2 call attempts.

- No response after 2 calls → order cancelled.

Missing / Wrong Information
On Hold Process
Includes:
- Missing / Wrong Address
- Missing / Wrong ID Number
- Missing 2nd Name

Process
- Customer called once to correct info.
- If no answer, order put on HOLD.
- 4 call attempts while on hold.
- No response → order cancelled.

Orders with Wrong Phone Numbers
Email Pending
Process
- Email sent to correct phone number.
- Email pending for 48 hours.
- No response → order cancelled.

Cancel Reason – Change in Mind
Customer Request
- Customer requested to cancel the order.

Fraud Customer
Immediate Cancel
Process
- Order cancelled immediately.
- No calls made.
- If customer requests refund:

                  ID & bank card required.
                  Refund processed after verification.

No Answer
Final Status
- Order was on HOLD.
- No response from customer.
- Order cancelled due to no answer.

#### Hold Reasons & Process

Blacklisted Category {COD (
C
ash
O
n

elivery) Orders}
- Blacklisted customers will be called once by a CCA to pay for the order, if there is no answer their order will be cancelled.

Risky Category {COD (
C
ash

n

elivery) Orders}
- The customer will be called once to pay for the order {CRM Assigned Order},  if there is no answer the order will be put on hold, after that the customer will be called 2 times and sent a message after each call while the order is on hold, if there is no answer after the 2 calls the order will be cancelled.

Missing/Wrong Address, Missing/Wrong ID Number, Missing 2nd name, Missing the customer's full name for Iraq & Jordan
- The customer will be called once to correct the wrong/missing information {CRM Assigned Order}, if there is no answer the order will be put on hold, after that the customer will be called 4 times while the order is on hold, if there is no answer after the 4 calls the order will be cancelled.

Orders with wrong numbers
- An email will be sent to the customer to correct their phone number and the email will be pending for 48 hours, if there is no answer the order will be cancelled.

#### Cancel Reasons

Change In Mind

- The customer changed their mind and asked to cancel their order.

Fraud Customer

- Orders made from a  fraud category account must be cancelled, no calls will be made to the customer.
- To ensure the security of transactions, Incase the customer is a fraud and after cancelling the order we receive a phone call from the customer asking for a refund we will ask the customer to provide a copy of their ID card and bank card for verification purposes.
- Once the customer's identity is confirmed, the refund team will process the refund for the order amount accordingly.

No Answer

- The order was on HOLD and there was no answer from the customer.

title: International Charges / Vat & Tax
content:
#### COD Orders Confirmation Process

COD Orders – Confirmation Process
Guidelines on how to confirm Cash on Delivery orders.
1

### Confirming COD Orders

⌄
COD All COD orders require customer confirmation.

- Customer must be contacted before confirmation.
- VIP customers are excluded.
- No confirmation = no order processing.

2

### Duplicate COD Orders

⌄
Important All duplicate orders must be verified.

- Contact customer regardless of category.
- Confirm duplication reason.
- Inform about separate COD & delivery charges.

Scenario:
Duplicate orders due to payment limit.
Correct Action
✔ Contact customer
✔ Explain charges
✔ Proceed only after confirmation
3

### Multiple COD Shipments & Charges

⌄
- Multiple orders = multiple COD & shipping charges.
- Orders can be combined only after stock verification.
- Country cart-value rules must be respected.

4

### VIP Customers (Diamond, Gold, Silver)

⌄
VIP Special handling applies.

- Do not confirm multiple orders immediately.
- Attempt customer contact.
- If no response, confirm only one order.

#### COD orders confirmation process guidelines

Confirming COD orders
- For all categories customers with COD order, they will be contacted to provide confirmation prior to confirming their orders. (Excluding VIP customers).

Duplicate COD Orders
- In case of Duplicated-Orders, all customers will be contacted regardless of their Category, First to confirm that the duplicated order wasn't by accident and if the customer created duplicated order due to payment threshold, the customer has to be informed that he will pay separate COD-charges & Delivery-charges for every order.

Multiple COD Shipments Charges
- For multiple orders we must inform the customer that there will be two separate shipping charges and COD charges associated with each order. We can combine the orders into one shipment after verifying the availability of items in stock with taking into consideration the agreed cart value for each country.

VIP Customers {Diamond-Gold-Silver}
- If VIP customers ("Diamond, Gold, Silver") have duplicate orders, CCAs will refrain from confirming multiple orders until the customer answers the call. Only one order will be confirmed if there is no response from the customer.

title: Order Preparation Process
content:
#### Order Preparation Process

## The Order Preparation Process

A Comprehensive Overview of the Workflow from Order Placement to Delivery This process outlines the systematic steps taken from the moment an order is placed through to its final delivery.

Local Orders Preparation Process

1st Step

### CRM Pending

The order has been placed by the customer and is pending confirmation.

2nd Step

### CRM Assigned

The order has been assigned to an associate who will review the order details. If necessary, the associate will contact the customer to verify specific information or directly confirm the order.

3rd Step

### Confirm

The order has been confirmed, and the warehouse team will now begin processing the order.

4th Step

### Warehouse Processed

Batch Created
The orders details has been printed and the warehouse team started processing the order.

Picked
The Products has been picked up from the warehouse shelves.

Order Allocation
The products has been allocated and gathered to be sorted.

Sorted
The order has been sorted and is ready to be packed.

5th Step

### Packed

The order has been packed and will be handed to logistics department.

6th Step

### Manifested

The order was transferred to the manifestation area where the logistics team will prepare the order for delivery.

7th Step

### Shelved

Logistics picked up the order and shelved it for delivery.

8th Step

### Ready To Ship

The order was handed to the delivery representative and is ready to be delivered.

9th Step

### Shipped

The order has been shipped and will be delivered to the customer on the same day.

10th Step

### Delivered

The order has been delivered successfully to the customer.

International Orders Preparation Process

What's Different from Local order preparation process?

1st Step
After the order has been Packed an AWB {Air Way Bill} Number will be created for the order.
2nd Step
The order status will be
Shipped
, but the order has not been actually shipped yet {Still in the warehouse with the Outbound team}.
3rd Step
The order will be picked by the the courier {Shipping Company}.
4th Step
The order will be shipped to the customer's country for delivery.
5th Step
The order will be delivered.

#### Tabby Q&A's

Here are some common questions and answers about Tabby.

In which countries is tabby available?
- Tabby payment method is available for Kuwait, KSA, and UAE.

What is the credit limit of Tabby?
- There is no set limit for how many purchases that can be placed with tabby if approved by tabby

What does Tabby require when a customer uses Tabby for the first time?
- **Kuwait & UAE:** Customers must **upload an image of the back side of their ID**.
- **KSA:** Customers only need to **enter their ID information** (no upload required).

After entering the ID details, KSA customers will receive an **extra OTP verification** due to local regulations.

Can customers purchase gift cards using tabby payment method?
- Gift cards cannot be purchased with Tabby.

Can customers use existing store credit funds with tabby to partially pay for their orders?
- Boutiqaat store credit cannot be used with Tabby at the same time; it is restricted from the App.

Can I create an order using CRM and choose tabby as a payment method?
- Orders created from CRM will not be able to use Tabby as a payment method; the order must be placed from the App.

Can customers exchange products when the payment gateway is tabby?
- Local Customers Can request an exchange Twice and the product must match the existing products price.
- International Customers: Can request an exchange Twice and the product must match the existing products price.

If the customer paid with Tabby, how long does the refund take and where is it refunded?
In all cases, Tabby refunds are returned to the customer’s **Tabby account inside the Tabby app** (not store credit, not bank).

**Refund SLA (by order type):**

- **Local Orders:** **3–5 working days** → refunded to the customer’s **Tabby account in the Tabby app**.
- **International Orders:** **5–7 working days** → refunded to the customer’s **Tabby account in the Tabby app**.

What if tabby’s payment method is not showing up to a customer?
- The customer has to contact tabby’s customer service to check their account eligibility.

### Permission Snapshot

- **Full time:** 6h balance
- Starts: **15th** of the month
- Expires: **14th** of next month

### Sick Leave Snapshot

## Schedule

Full time vs Intern schedule rules (shift ratio, hours, off days, leaves, comp off).

### Schedule Rules (Summary)

| Type | Shift Ratio | Shift Hours | OFF Days | Annual Leaves | Comp Off |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Full time** | Based on shift needs | 9h | 2 days | 30 days annually | Comp Off (applicable) |
| **Intern** | Based on shift needs | 9h | 2 days | Not Applicable | Comp Off (applicable) |

Notes
- Shift assignment follows business coverage and staffing needs.
- Always validate your schedule placement (see Technical Issues → Check Schedule).
- Any exceptions should be raised through the approved WFM channel / helpdesk.

### Quick Process: Check Schedule Placement

1. Open your schedule view (tool/system used by WFM).
2. Confirm the correct **date**, **shift**, and **role**.
3. Validate breaks & permissions balance alignment.
4. If incorrect: submit a request via helpdesk (include screenshots).

### Quick Process: Swap / Change Shift

1. Check both agents’ eligibility (coverage, rules, approvals).
2. Submit **Swap Shift** request (see Technical Issues).
3. Wait for WFM confirmation before acting on the change.
4. Re-check schedule after approval.

## WFM Teams

### Contact Center Hub

## Time Off

How to submit time off requests, breaks, and permissions (policy-driven).

### Breaks

Breaks listed in your draft:

- 15 min

- 15 min

Breaks
Follow schedule placement

### How to Submit Time Off (Permission)

1. Check your **permission balance** and expiry window.
2. Submit the permission request via **Odoo HR Bot** (see HR Bot page).
3. Include date/time window and reason.
4. Track approval and re-check your schedule.

Policy details are in **Permission Policy**.

### Common Time Off Requests

| Request Type | Where to Submit | Key Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Permission** | Odoo HR Bot | Balance cycles monthly (15th → 14th). FT 6h, Intern 2h. |
| **Sick Leave** | Odoo HR Bot | FT max normal 3 days; beyond requires medical report. Intern 1 paid/month. |
| **Annual Leave** | Odoo HR Bot | Paid in advance + deduction policy rules apply. |
| **Comp Off** | Odoo HR Bot | Check expiry date and submit within allowed window. |

## Permission Policy

Full time vs Intern permission balance rules, cycle dates, and expiry.

### Full Time

- Agents have **6h permission** on their balance.
- Starts on the **15th** day of the month.
- Expires on the **14th** day of the next month.

6h balance
Expires monthly

### Intern

- Interns have **2h permission** on their balance.
- Starts on the **15th** day of the month.
- Expires on the **14th** day of the next month.

2h balance
Expires monthly

### Submission Guidance

1. Before submitting: confirm your remaining balance and your schedule coverage.
2. Submit via **Odoo HR Bot** with the exact time window.
3. Follow the **paid vs unpaid** deduction policy rules in HR Bot page.
4. If submission fails: use **Technical Issues → Form** or **Helpdesk**.

## Sick Leave

Full time and Intern sick leave balances and medical report requirements.

### Full Time

- Agents have **15 sick leave days** in their balance.
- Balance applies from **start of year** to **end of year**.
- Maximum normal sick leave: **3 days**.
- More than 3 days: **medical report must be submitted**.

15 days/year
Medical report after 3 days

### Intern

- Interns have **1 paid sick leave** on their balance.
- Starts on the **1st day** of the month.
- Expires at the **end of the month**.

1 day/month
Monthly expiry

### How to Submit Sick Leave

1. Submit via **Odoo HR Bot**.
2. Choose sick leave type and dates.
3. Attach medical report if required (FT > 3 days).
4. Review the **paid + unpaid deduction policy** rules (HR Bot page).

## Odoo HR Bot

Step-by-step request types handled in Odoo (permissions, leaves, extra hours, deductions, payslips, etc.).

### Requests Available in Odoo HR Bot

| Request | What to Submit | Important Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Permissions (paid + unpaid)** | Time window + reason | Follow deduction policy based on balance and approval. |
| **Sick Leaves (paid + unpaid)** | Dates + attachment (if required) | FT: medical report needed if > 3 days. |
| **Annual Leaves (Paid in advance)** | Start/end dates + plan | Deduction policy applies if balance is insufficient. |
| **Extra Hours** | Date + hours + justification | Must align with overtime policy/contract. |
| **Comp Off** | Date + reference + hours | Check the **expiry date** before submitting. |
| **Leave Resumption** | Resumption date | Submit within required timeline. |
| **Staff Discount** | Request details | Submit as per eligibility rules. |
| **Penalties & Deductions** | View/check | Use HR Bot to verify deductions and reasons. |
| **Payslips** | View/download | Check latest payslip period and download. |
| **Other Leaves** | Type + duration + documents | Rules vary per leave type (see Policies). |
| **Submit Request Duration** | Duration/timeframe | Some requests have cut-off timelines. |

### General Submission Checklist

1. Confirm **balance** and **expiry**.
2. Submit request in HR Bot with correct dates/times.
3. Attach supporting documents when required.
4. Track approval status.
5. Re-check schedule after approval.

### Paid vs Unpaid (Deductions)

- **Paid:** request is covered by the available balance.
- **Unpaid:** balance is insufficient or policy requires unpaid deduction.
- Always validate the deduction outcome before submission.

title: Article 08 – WhatsApp Account & Return/Exchange During the Call
content:
Article 08 – WhatsApp Account & Return/Exchange During the Call
**What’s happening?**

For improving the FCR, you now have your own WhatsApp account, and “Return/Exchange” will be processed during the call.

**What do I need to know?**

- Inform customers that the request of “Return/Exchange” will be done during the call.
- Receive the item picture from customers during the call.
- Create the CIR/Exchange ticket and upload the picture during the call.
- For VIP customers (Diamond/Gold/Silver), start proceeding with the Return/Exchange without asking for a picture.
- Please ask all customers, including VIP (Diamond/Gold/Silver), to send pictures only if the reason is “Change in mind.”
- Do not inform customers about accepting the Return/Exchange for “Change in mind” before checking that the pictures show the items are in original condition.

#### Ameyo Ticket Status:

| Status | Follow up | Pending | Close |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CX wants to Exchange |  | CX will send the pic later | CX sent the pic during the call |
| CX wants to Return | CX sent the pic during the call | CX will send the pic later | Refund done |

#### Noting:

- For pending status, SLA will be 48H — the ticket will be closed if the customer didn’t send the picture.
- If you will leave the item for the customer as a compensation, make sure that the item price is less than 20KD; if more, please take an exception from your superior.
- Don’t forget to check that “Return required” on the ticket is set to **NO** — do not mention it only in the ticket comment.

title: Article 101 – New Confirmation Process for COD Orders in Iraq and Qatar
content:
Article 101 – New Confirmation Process for COD Orders in Iraq and Qatar
**Dear Team,**

In our ongoing commitment to provide exceptional service to our valued customers in Iraq and Qatar, we will be implementing a new Confirmation Process for Cash On Delivery orders:-
  Below are guidelines for the new confirmation process, kindly pay attention to the process of handling the confirmation based on customers Category:-

#### New Confirmation Process for COD Orders in Iraq and Qatar

- All categories of customers with COD orders (excluding VIP) will be contacted to confirm their order before it’s processed.
- In case of duplicated orders, all customers will be contacted to confirm the reason. If due to payment threshold, inform them that each order will incur separate COD and delivery charges.
- For multiple orders, inform customers of separate shipping and COD charges for each. Orders may be combined only after stock availability is confirmed, considering the country-specific cart value agreement.
- If VIP customers (Diamond, Gold, Silver) have duplicated orders, do not confirm more than one unless the customer answers the call.

#### Iraq COD Cart Limit Update:

The COD cart limit in Iraq is now set to **$200** (cart value only). With additional charges, the total becomes **$244.65**.

title: Article 14 – Chat Closing Protocol
content:
Article 14 – Chat Closing Protocol
**What’s happening?**

We have two scenarios for the chat closing protocol. The important factor here is the timing before ending your conversation with the customer.

**What do I need to know?**

#### 1st Scenario:

If you replied to the customer's needs and do not require any more information, but the customer didn’t reply with any further requests or even a “thank you”:

- Wait for **1 minute**, then send the *“Any other service” template*.
- Wait for another **1 minute**. If no reply, send the *“In case we didn't receive reply” template* & *“Feedback SMS” template*.
- After another **1 minute**, send the *“Don’t hesitate” template*.

#### 2nd Scenario:

If you asked for important information from the customer to solve the problem but the customer didn’t reply:

- Wait for **1 minute**, then send the *“In case we didn't receive reply” template*.
- Wait for another **1 minute**. If no reply, send the *“Feedback SMS” template*.
- After another **1 minute**, send the *“Don’t hesitate” template*.

title: Article 144 – Food Policy
content:
Article 144 – Food Policy
Dear **@CC_Contact Center**,

We trust this message finds you well.

As we continue to foster a positive and collaborative work environment, we would like to address a topic that plays a significant role in our daily lives — **food etiquette in the workplace**.

All below instructions are to be followed inside the floor (Stations/Desks):

- **Meals are Forbidden on Stations/Desks:**
          Feel free to enjoy your meal in the designated break area and kitchen. However, we kindly request your understanding that heating certain foods can sometimes create strong smells that may be unpleasant for others. Your consideration in this matter is greatly appreciated.

          *- Both cold and hot meals included.*

**Snacks which are NOT allowed on the floor:**

- Chips
- Seeds
- Chewing Gum
- Any food which may cause crumbs or debris on floor or station/desk

**Snacks which are ALLOWED on the Stations/Desks:**

- Raw Nuts
- Cold Sandwiches
- Fruits

We trust that all employees will adhere to this policy to maintain a hygienic, clean, positive, and respectful work environment.
      Non-compliance to the above may result in further actions as necessary.

Thank you for your cooperation in making our Contact Center a place where everyone feels comfortable and appreciated.

Regards,

title: Article 165 – Coupon Code
content:
Article 165 – Coupon Code
**Dear Team,**

Please be aware of the clarification below regarding **handling discount code inquiries
          on Social Media channels**.

#### **What’s the clarification?**

When a customer **publicly comments** requesting or inquiring about a
        **discount code** (whether general or specific), the response handling must follow
        the guidelines below.

#### **What do I need to do?**

- **Do not reply publicly** to comments requesting or asking about discount codes.
- Always **communicate with the customer privately** via Direct Message (DM).
- Use the **approved scripts** when responding privately, depending on whether a
          discount code is active or not.

**⚠️ Important:**

          Discount code information must **never be shared publicly** in comments under
          social media posts.

#### **Scenario 1: No Active Discount Code**

If there is **no active discount code**, reply to the customer privately using the
        approved script below.

**English Script:**

Thanks for contacting Boutiqaat! Coupon code is not available right now,
          we'll notify you when it is available to make sure you're the first to know.

**Arabic Script:**

شكراً لتواصلك مع بوتيكات! رمز القسيمة غير متوفر لدينا حاليًا،
          وسنقوم بإبلاغك فور توفره لتكون أول من يستفيد منه.

#### **Scenario 2: Active Discount Code Available**

In case there is an **active discount code available in the app**, you are
        **required to inform the customer of the active code privately**.

**Example:** If there is an **active code**, clearly inform the
        customer of the code details via private message.

title: Article 192 – Email Etiquette Guidelines
content:
Article 192 – Email Etiquette Guidelines
**What’s happening?**

Below are key guidelines for maintaining professional email etiquette.

**What do I need to know?**

**Guidelines for email etiquette:**

1. **Font Styles and Font Size for Email:** Font type should be “Calibri” and font size should be “11”.
2. **Clear, professional subject line:** Show your recipient clearly what the email will cover. A concise subject line helps recipients prioritize and manage their inbox efficiently.
3. **Proofread every email you send:** Check for spelling, grammar, punctuation, and correct recipient name. This ensures professionalism.
4. **Double check you have the correct recipient:** Avoid sending emails or confidential documents to the wrong person, department, or client.
5. **Reply to your emails:** Acknowledge receipt if you can’t respond immediately. This shows professionalism and consideration.
6. **Include a signature block:** Add your full name, title, company, and contact number to assure authenticity.
7. **Use the appropriate level of formality:** Start with “Dear ___”, use polite terms like “please” and “thank you”, and close with “Kind regards”, “Thank you”, or “Sincerely”.
8. **Keep emails brief and to the point:** Avoid overly long texts. Suggest follow-ups or calls for further clarification if needed.

title: Article 234 – Return Process Policy for International Orders
content:
Article 234 – Return Process Policy for International Orders
Dear Team,
Kindly check the below article regarding the new return process of international orders.

#### What’s new?

- Starting from Wednesday, April 9, Boutiqaat will afford the cost of all change-in-mind returns for international orders.

#### What do I need to know?

1. The new process of return for international orders for change-in-mind reason will no longer be at the customer's cost.
2. Once the customer contacts us to return an item(s) under the reason change-in-mind, we must ensure the item is in good and original condition.
3. The CIR ticket will be created on the spot with the RAWB mentioned in the ticket.

#### Why is this important?

The company will cover the return cost to ensure a flexible, smooth return process and provide a great customer experience.

#### Next updates

**Update 1:**

      Always insert the Return AWB No (RAWB) in the highlighted field before creating a CIR ticket for international returns, for all reasons (change-in-mind, defective item, etc.).

**Update 2 (Effective 4/20/2025):**

      All Change-in-Mind international returns will NOT have to wait for QC results for the refund to be processed. Once pickup is done, refund will be processed bypassing QC check.

      However, agents creating the CIR ticket must confirm items are in their original condition (label, plastic cover, etc.).

      This update affects refund team processes but is important for all teams to be aware.

**Update 3:**

      For international change-in-mind exchange requests, the company now covers the shipping cost of returning products to Kuwait.

      Key points:

      1. Once the customer provides valid pictures showing items in original condition, the agent creates the RAWB and exchange ticket simultaneously.

      2. Insert RAWB number in both the RAWB field and comments.

      3. After creating the exchange order, un-hold then hold it again to prevent auto-confirmation.

      4. Confirm exchange order once pickup is confirmed by the carrier.

      5. The agent creating the exchange order is accountable until pickup and confirmation are done.

**Related to International change-in-mind Return CIR:**

      After creating the CIR ticket and inserting the RAWB in the "Return AWB No" field, the RAWB number must also be inserted inside the CIR ticket until further notice.

Refer to the Knowledge Base for detailed processes under "Return CIR Process" and "Exchange Process".

**Update 4:**

      Use the new hold reason to hold exchange orders until the item is picked up from the customer.

**Update 5:**

      Exchange has been re-enabled for Saudi orders, both warehouses, and for all exchange reasons.

**Update 6:**

      Issues related to KSA exchange are resolved, including:

      - Exchange for KSA warehouse

      - Exchange for Tabby & Tamara for KSA orders

      - Exchange for mixed orders

      All above now applicable including genuine exchange cases.

**Update 7:**

      The 2nd exchange for Tamara payment method is now applicable in all countries that have Tamara.

      Customers can now exchange twice regardless of the payment method.

Thank you for your commitment and attention.

title: Article 257 – Customer Complaints Ownership – A Non-Negotiable Responsibility
content:
Article 257 – Customer Complaints Ownership – A Non-Negotiable Responsibility
**Dear team,**

Kindly check the below article.

### What’s happening?

We’re sharing a reminder about one of the core principles of customer service excellence — owning and following up on customer complaints.

### What do I need to know?

Owning and following up on customer complaints, regardless of the nature of the issue, is always our responsibility to ensure that the complaint is resolved and the customer is updated.

This applies even when the system is not available or is temporarily unable to process an action during the customer's interaction. In such cases, we should **never** ask the customer to contact us again later. Instead, we must own the case and follow up once the system allows us to take the needed action.

#### Key point to keep in mind:

**Exchange/Return requests:** If the customer requests a return or exchange, but the system has not yet reflected the “Delivered” status of the shipment, we still own the case.

**Take note of the request, and follow this process:**

- Locally, escalate the order to the senior/leader.
- Internationally, attempt to update the shipment status using the "check shipment status" function.
- If the shipment didn’t update and was shown as delivered in the carrier portal, hold the order with you for an hour. If the issue persists, share a technical issue internally (not with the customer).
- If the shipment wasn’t updated as delivered in the carrier’s portal, reach out to the carrier company.
- Initiate the request action ticket as soon as the system updates. (Ameyo ticket remains follow-up until the customer's request is created.)
- **Do not inform the customer** about the technical issue.

Let us know if you have any questions or need further clarification.

Thank you for your commitment towards all our core principles.

title: Article 268 – Duplicated Unpaid Orders in App
content:
Article 268 – Duplicated Unpaid Orders in App
**Dear Team,**

Kindly check the article below,

### What’s new?

We are sharing with you insights and a policy to follow when receiving an inquiry about Duplicated or Unpaid orders showing for the customer in the App.

### What do I need to know?

Whenever the application shows additional orders to the customer after they have:

- Backed off from the payment page before processing,
- Entered wrong payment information,
- Or even after a successful payment,

The app may display those additional orders due to a technical flow.

The additional orders should be removed automatically from the app within **90 minutes**.

If any order isn't removed within the 90 minutes, you should double check the payment provider portal (Myfatoraah, Tabby, Tamara) through you or the senior on the shift. Follow these steps:

- If the portal confirms that the payment is failed, then you should raise a technical form for the order to be removed manually from the customer's orders list.

title: Article 270 – QC Remarks for Defective Electronics & Underwear Returns Policy
content:
Article 270 – QC Remarks for Defective Electronics & Underwear Returns Policy

#### 📢 Update – 9/11/2025

Dear Team,

We’ve noticed that the escalated electronic cases are not always clearly explained to the Refund and RPC teams. Kindly make sure to **mention the issue of the device in the comment box** in the CIR ticket.

**✶ For example:**

- Power bank is working but charges very slowly.
- Hair dryer is working but there’s no heat.
- Smartwatch is working but unable to connect via Bluetooth.

Providing a clear explanation is important to help identify the exact issue, ensure a faster process, and guide the RPC team on which part of the device to inspect in the warehouse.

The agreed script we will follow in SMS and other channels:

| English Script | Arabic Script |
| --- | --- |
| Dear Customer,            Please note that the product has been received and thoroughly inspected by the concerned department, and it was found to be free of any damage.            Your item will be returned to you accordingly.             Boutiqaat wishes you a good day! | عميلنا العزيز،            نود إعلامك بأنه تم استلام المنتج وفحصه بشكل كامل من قبل القسم المختص، وتبيّن أنه لا يوجد به أي تلف.            سيتم استرجاع المنتج الخاص بك في أقرب وقت ممكن.             بوتيكات تتمنى لك يوماً سعيداً. |

**Dear Team,**

Kindly check the below article for return policy updates.

#### 📌 What’s new?

The return policy for **electronic items and underwear** has been updated and reflected in the FAQs.

#### ℹ️ What do I need to know?

##### 👕 Apparel (Socks, Underwear, Swimwear, and Leggings)

- These items can only be returned within **one day** from the delivery date, provided they remain sealed and in their original condition.
- If the customer contacts us within one day but shares the required pictures after 24 hours, the return or exchange will **not be accepted** in accordance with Kuwait’s commercial law and for hygiene and public health reasons.

##### 💻 Electronic Products

- Returns or exchanges will not be accepted if the product has been used, damaged, or modified after delivery.
- In used cases, the product will be returned to the customer without replacement, refund, or compensation.
- The **RPC team** will mark the QC remark as **“USED”** if the electronic item is found to be fully functional and undamaged.
- The **Refund team** must then reject the CIR ticket accordingly.
- The Refund team will also coordinate with RPC via email to confirm the used component and to inform the customer of the refund rejection.

##### 🕓 Request Completion Timeline

- If a customer initiates a return or exchange request within **14 days** but fails to provide the required media or actions within that period, and later follows up after 14 days, the request will not be completed as per the **Ministry of Commerce regulations in Kuwait**.
- If a returned product is used, opened, or not in its original condition and the customer refuses to collect it after rejection, they will have **14 days** to pick it up.
- If not collected within this period, **Boutiqaat** will dispose of the item without any responsibility or future claims from the customer, in order to maintain quality and protect other products.

🔗 [View Updated Return Policy](https://support.boutiqaat.com/exchange-return-items)

Article 271 - Auto Refund For Cancel Ticket

Update – 27/10/2025:
Dear Team,

          Please note that **Auto Refund for KSA** has been **disabled** for cancel tickets. Removing the option from your display is currently in progress.

          Be aware that **Auto Refund for Tabby and Tamara** for cancel tickets across all countries **remains available**.

Update – 16/10/2025:
- **Auto Refund by Bank (KSA only)** does **not** include **partially paid** orders with Store Credit — only **fully bank-paid** orders are auto-refunded.
- For the above excluded cases, CRM will **not allow** selecting a refund gateway under *Auto Refund*.

**Dear Team,**

Kindly check the below article for our latest automation.

#### 📌 What’s new?

**Cancel Tickets Refund** has been automated and will be executed by the system smoothly within minutes.

##### ✅ Payment Gateways included for Cancel Tickets

- **Refund to Tabby**
- **Refund to Tamara**
- **Refund by Bank** (**KSA only**)

#### ℹ️ What do I need to know?

- In the cancel pop-up, you will have two new fields: **Refund Type** and **Refund Gateway**.
- When cancelling an order paid with **Tabby** or **Tamara**, select **Refund Type = Auto Refund** and choose **Refund Gateway** as *Tabby* or *Tamara* accordingly.
- **CRM** will auto-execute the refund in the cancel ticket and **close the ticket**. The amount is transferred from **Boutiqaat** within minutes.
- **Refund SLA** remains unchanged.
- **No SMS** will be sent to the customer when the cancel ticket is closed.
- Orders paid **fully with Store Credit** continue to auto-refund as before; in this case, select **Refund Type = Manual Refund**.
- For **KSA bank refunds** requested by the customer, select **Refund Type = Auto Refund** and choose the available payment method.
- If **Manual Refund** is selected, you **cannot** choose the Refund Gateway; the **Refund Team** will select it inside the ticket.
- **Warehouse Processed** cancellations follow the same flow. The system will prevent not-applicable refund selections; please still verify the flow carefully.

#### 🧭 Action Guide

| Scenario | Refund Type | Refund Gateway | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Order paid via **Tabby** | Auto Refund | Tabby | CRM executes refund and closes ticket. |
| Order paid via **Tamara** | Auto Refund | Tamara | CRM executes refund and closes ticket. |
| **KSA** customer requested **Bank refund** (fully paid by bank) | Auto Refund | Bank (KSA) | Gateway available only for eligible KSA bank-paid orders. |
| Order paid **fully with Store Credit** | Manual Refund | — | System auto-refunds store credit as before; gateway selection not required. |
| **Manual Refund** chosen by agent | Manual Refund | — | Refund Team selects gateway inside the ticket. |
| **Warehouse Processed** order (cancellation) | Same as above | As applicable | System blocks invalid selections; verify flow before submitting. |

*Tip:* Always double-check the payment breakdown before choosing the Refund Type/Gateway, and add a brief note in CRM (who requested, method selected, and reason).

title: Article 281 – National Address ID Requirement for Saudi

Article 281 – National Address ID Requirement for Saudi
**Dear Team,**

Kindly be aware of the **new Saudi address requirement** related to
          the **National Address ID**.

#### **What’s new?**

A **new Saudi National Address ID** has been introduced by the
        Saudi government, which **summarizes all address details into a single ID**.

#### **What do I need to know?**

- The **National Address ID** is a unique code representing addresses inside Saudi Arabia.
- Saudi customers creating a **new address** are required to enter the National Address ID.
- The address **cannot be saved** without entering the National Address ID.
- If a customer attempts to use an **old address** that does not contain a National Address ID,
          they will be **prompted to enter it**.
- Customers can find their National Address ID through the official link:

          [https://splonline.com.sa/ar/national-address-1/](https://splonline.com.sa/ar/national-address-1/)
- Starting from **2026**, the app will **not allow order creation**
          unless the National Address ID is entered, as deliveries will not be allowed without it.

Visual example showing where customers can find and identify the Saudi National Address ID

**⚠️ Important:**

title: Article 287 – Awaiting Response Protocol (Sprinklr)
content:
Article 287 – Awaiting Response Protocol (Sprinklr)
**Update (26/4/2026):**

Dear Team,

Hope all is well with you,

Kindly be aware of these release amendments,

Awaiting Response Protocol will be used with greeting only conversations, effective from this update.

The previous policy concluded using the awaiting response protocol only if the customer provided an inquiry, request, complaint, which left greeting cases outside the scope and to be resolved.

The new policy will include the cases where customers send us greeting only and then after your "How may I help you?" message, you will implement the awaiting response protocol.

This change is to avoid the system from creating a new case for the customer once he re-contacts after sending his greeting, as the first case used to be resolved with since no response protocol.

The contact reason to use will be "Undefined Customer Cases"

If a customer sends a Thank you or an Acknowledge of the previous case, we can't close the case with resolved without response as the Resolve Macro can't be applied without a response from the assigned agent to the case in the conversation.

Reply to the customer with wish0(سعيد0) canned response, and then apply the Resolved Macro.

Only ask the customer "How may I help you?" if he hasn't sent any smallest indicator of inquiry, request, complaint.

Below canned response has been added in Sprinklr and it will auto insert your name in the text.

**Canned Response:**

| **Shortcut** | 000_Protocols_En / 000_Protocols_Ar |
| --- | --- |
| **Name** | 000 - greeting2 / 000 - التحية2 |
| **Message** | Thank you for contacting Boutiqaat… I'm *Agent Name*.              شكرا لتواصلك مع بوتيكات...معك *Agent Name*. |

**Dear Team,**

As clarity has improved on the Awaiting Response Protocol after one week of implementation — and based on your feedback — the following adjustments have been made.

#### **What’s new?**

- The waiting time before sending the **awaiting script** and **since script** has been reduced to **2 minutes instead of 3 minutes**.
        The sequence is now **(2 – 2)** instead of **(3 – 2)**.
- The waiting time after sending the **since script** has been updated depending on the case status.
- The **1-minute required wait before offering any other service** has been removed.

#### **What do I need to know?**

#### 1. Updated Waiting Time Before Since Script

- You are required to wait **2 minutes** before sending the awaiting or since script.
- The updated sequence is now **(2 – 2)**.

#### 2. Waiting Time After Since Script

- **If the case is resolved:** Wait **1 minute only**.
- **If the case is placed on Awaiting Response:** Wait **2 minutes**.

#### 3. Any Other Service Handling

- The 1-minute waiting requirement has been removed.
- Only offer any other service once the customer’s issue has been fully resolved.

#### Example

- If a customer requests to edit their order and you inform them that editing is not available and cancellation with refund is the only option, do not immediately offer any other service.
- First confirm whether the customer would like to proceed with the refund option or continue with receiving the order.

The Awaiting Response Protocol now applies to both Social Media and Live Chat cases.
      Once WhatsApp is fully operating within Sprinklr, the same protocol will apply.

Thank you for your feedback on the first iteration of the Awaiting Response Protocol.

Updated

title: Article 291 – Chat Awaiting Duration Reduction (Ameyo)
content:
Article 291 – Chat Awaiting Duration Reduction (Ameyo)
Dear Team,

Kindly check the article regarding the new chat handling sequences update.

## What’s new?

Chat sequences and awaiting duration have been modified and decreased 📉 for chats that are currently being handled through Ameyo.

## What do I need to know?

#### Awaiting Customer Response (Picture / Information)

- When asking the customer to share a product picture or provide additional information, you are required to wait **2 minutes only** before sending the **since script**.
- After sending the since script, wait **2 minutes**. If there is still no response, send the **ending script** and close the chat.
- The total awaiting time is now **4 minutes (2 – 2)** instead of 5 minutes (3 – 2).

#### Any Other Service Handling

- The **1-minute await before offering any other service** has been cancelled.
- You must send any other service **immediately after providing your resolution/action** to the customer.
- After sending any other service, wait **2 minutes** before sending the **since script**, then wait **1 minute only** before sending the **ending script** (if no reply).
- Only offer **any other service** once the customer’s issue has been completely resolved — not just answered with information.

#### Example

- If a customer requests to edit their order and you inform them that editing is not available and that cancellation with refund is the only option, do not immediately ask for any other service.
- First, confirm whether the customer would like to proceed with the refund or continue with receiving the order.

Currently, this policy applies to **Ameyo chats only**. Sprinklr offers advanced functionality that will be introduced once WhatsApp moves to Sprinklr.

Let us know if you have any questions or feedback you would like to share.

content:
Article 293 – Deema - New Installments Payment Method

#### **Update History**

**Update – 16/03/2026**

- Please note that Auto Refund for cancel ticket is now officially active for your use when cancelling Deema Installment orders.

Dear Team,

Kindly check this Article regarding new payment method.

## What's new?

Deema installments payment method has been added in the application for **Kuwait customers** and has been deployed in the CRM.

(image)
(image)

## What do I need to know?

#### Refund SLA

- **Locally:** 3 – 5 Working Days

#### Partial / Full Refund Policy

- Deema processes refunds by deducting the refund amount from the customer's outstanding (future) installments and reallocating it sequentially to the paid installments.
- Full refunds will be processed directly to the customer's bank account.

#### Countries

- Kuwait only.

#### Exchange with SKUs – Price Difference

- **Same Price:** Exchange proceeds normally.
- **Less Price:** The difference amount will be deposited as Store Credit.

#### Additional Notes

- Creating an order via CRM using Deema Payment is **not applicable**.
- Deema does **not** have a Store Credit feature — the customer will receive direct refunds to their bank account if there are no outstanding installments for the same order.
- Refunds will be processed **manually** by the refund team at the current stage.

#### Deema Customer Service

- 📞 **Phone:** +965 9500 6065
- 📧 **Email:** [Support@deema.me](mailto:Support@deema.me)
- 🌐 **Official Website:** [https://deema.me/ar](https://deema.me/ar)

#### Customer Journey After Selecting Deema Payment

- After selecting the payment option, the customer will be directed to the **Deema Payment Page** inside the Boutiqaat App.
- The customer will be prompted to enter their **phone number**.
- A verification code will be sent to the customer via **WhatsApp**.
- After entering the code, the customer will be requested to enter their **Civil ID**.
- The customer is then required to authenticate via **"Kuwait Mobile ID" (هويتي)**.
- As a final step, if the installments have been approved, the customer will complete payment within the Deema interface.

#### No Late Charges

- If a customer is late on their installments, there are **no late charges** as Deema is in compliance with Shariah.
- In the occurrence of late payments, the customer's **eligibility profile will be impacted**, limiting their access to the Deema installments service.
- Late payments may also impact the customer's **CINET** (financial credit eligibility across the Kuwait network).

content:
Article 299 – Sprinklr Canned Response (Scripts)
**Dear Team,**

Kindly check the article regarding **scripts in Sprinklr**.

#### **What's new?**

- A **canned response** is a ready-made script that you can use when chatting with customers in Sprinklr. Instead of typing the same message every time, you just **search and click** — and the message will appear in the text box automatically.

#### **What do I need to know?**

- A full list of all available scripts in Ameyo has been added in Sprinklr. You can find it in the **Knowledge Base** under the Sprinklr section.

(image)

#### **How to Use the Canned Response Widget:**

1. Navigate to the **Canned Response Widget** inside the case.
2. Type a **keyword** in the search bar to find the script you need.
3. **Click on the script** and it will go straight into the text box — ready to send.
4. Click the **favorite icon** ⭐ on any script to save it. This way you can find it quickly next time.
5. **Recently Used Scripts** — the widget also shows scripts you've used recently for quick access.

#### **Can You Create Your Own Scripts?**

**No** — you cannot create scripts inside Sprinklr. However, if you need to create your own personal shortcuts, you can use a free tool called **TextBlaze**:

🛠️ **TextBlaze** — a browser extension that lets you type a short keyword and it will automatically expand into a full message.

⚠️ **Please note:** TextBlaze shortcuts are for **personal use only**. Always make sure your responses follow the team's guidelines.

#### **🆕 Update: 31/3/2026**

We are sharing with you a demonstration on how to use the **shortcuts** of the canned responses in Sprinklr:

1. First point to be aware of is that in Sprinklr we will have to enter the character **"/"** in the textbox and then the script shortcut.
2. Second, **shortcuts can't be named in Arabic**, so the replacing methodology is **numbering the scripts**, and they are to be referred to as the **code of the script**.

- Fully disable **Email Notifications** to prevent Outlook storage overflow and ensure uninterrupted communication.

#### **Problem Statement**

Users are receiving **multiple notifications for the same message** due to overlapping notification triggers within the system.

#### **How to Access Notification Settings**

- Click on the **Notifications icon** at the bottom left of the screen.
- Select the **Settings icon** within the Notifications tab.
- Navigate to **Case Management** from the left-side menu.

#### **What You Should Turn Off Only**

You are allowed to disable the following notifications only:

- **Case Assigned Notification:** Triggered whenever a new case is assigned to you.
- **Case Workflow Updated Notification:** Triggered after applying a macro and duplicated by another system notification.
- **New Fan Message Associated:** Triggered for every incoming customer message across related cases.

**Important:** Disabling any notifications outside of the above list is **not permitted**, as system notifications are part of the official communication workflow.

#### **Additional Actions (Latest Update)**

- Disable notifications triggered for every message sent to customers.
- Turn off all **Email Notifications** completely.

title: Article 305 – Handling WhatsApp Cases Beyond 24-Hour Window
content:
Article 305 – Handling WhatsApp Cases Beyond 24-Hour Window
**Dear Team,**

Kindly be aware of this guideline regarding **WhatsApp cases that were not replied to within the 24-hour window**, as per Meta policies.

**Important Policy:**

- You cannot reply to a customer if no response was sent within **24 hours** of their last message.
- The **reply box will be disabled** in such cases.
- You must follow the correct macro process based on the case status.

#### **Problem Statement**

WhatsApp cases exceeding the 24-hour reply window prevent agents from responding, requiring proper handling through macros and CRM updates.

#### **Scenario 1: Case Already Resolved**

- The reply box is disabled.
- The case was resolved via another channel (e.g., call, email, or other systems).

**Action to Take:**

- Apply **No Response Required Macro**.
- Select the correct resolution reason (e.g., Resolved via Ameyo).
- Use the same logic for other resolution channels.

#### **Scenario 2: Case Still Pending**

- The reply box is disabled.
- The case is not resolved and requires action or explanation.
- The customer may only have sent a greeting and is waiting for engagement.

**Action to Take:**

- Apply **Awaiting Response Macro**.
- Enter the **order number** if available.
- Select the correct **contact reason** based on the customer's message.
- If unclear, select **Undefined Customer Case**.

**Important:** Always ensure the correct macro and contact reason are selected to maintain accurate tracking and workflow efficiency.

#### **Additional Notes**

- The Customer Care Team will also handle these cases using the same process.
- Consistency in applying macros is mandatory.

Let us know if you have any questions or require further clarification.

#### CIR Important Q&A's

Here are some common questions and answers related to CIR Process.

What is QC, and what are the QC stages in CIR?​
**QC (Quality Check)** is the inspection process to confirm the item’s condition and decide whether it is **resalable**.

**QC Stages:**

- **QC Pass:** Item is in **original condition** and **can be resold**.
- **Return Put Away:** Item has been **placed back on the warehouse shelf** after return processing.
- **Return Close:** The return process is **completed**, and the **CIR ticket is closed**.

**Note:** QC status is visible inside the **CIR ticket**.

Do we always need to wait for QC before issuing a refund?​

### Local Orders

- **Yes**, we wait for **QC updates** for all reasons **except**: **Totally Damaged**.

### International Orders

- If the reason is **Damaged Item / Damaged Electronic / Wrong Item** → once the item is **picked up**, the refund is processed.
- If the reason is **Change in Mind** → once the item is **picked up**, the refund is processed.

What do we do if the item is QC Fail (Local Orders)?
- If the return/exchange reason is **Change of Mind** and the item is **QC Fail** (not in original condition), the item will be **returned back to the customer**.
- If the customer **refuses delivery** or **doesn’t request pickup**, the item will be **destroyed after 14 days**.

If an (International return) is QC Fail, what happens next?​
- As per the new return policy, the product amount will be refunded once the product is picked up from the customer.
- If the item fails QC, Boutiqaat will handle the cost.

Do we require pictures for return requests? When are pictures mandatory?​
- **Change of mind:** A product picture is **mandatory for all customers**.
- **Defective product:** A picture is required and must be **uploaded in CRM within the ticket**.
- **VIP customers (Diamond / Gold / Silver):** No picture is required for **defective, Damaged or Wrong products** cases.

What if the customer refuses to hand over the item unless we refund first?
- If the customer refuses to hand over the **wrong/defective/damaged** item before receiving the refund, the decision will be based on:

**Customer category**, and

**Customer history**
- Action taken: either **complete the refund** or **hold the refund** until the item is received.

content:
# Return NDR Process

## NDR: Non Delivery Return

Means that the order has been packed, manifested, shelved, reshelved, ready to ship, or shipped, and the customer is requesting to cancel it.

![image](/web/image/546-91115ce2/1.png)
![image](/web/image/952-15d6d410/2.webp)

![image](/web/image/547-76485bcd/7.png)
![image](/web/image/550-81b003aa/8.png)
Previous
Next

### NDR Important Q&A's

Here are some common questions and answers related to NDR Process.

Do I need to send a cancellation email before creating an NDR ticket for local orders?​
- No email required (create/continue without emailing Logistics)
- If the local order status is: **Packed, Manifested, Customer Denied, Re-shelved, or Shelved**
- **No cancellation email is needed** to Logistics.

We only wait for the **QC (Quality Check) update**.
- Email required before creating NDR
- If the local order status is: **Shipped** or **Ready to Ship**
- Send a **cancellation email** first.

Once **Logistics confirms the cancellation**, then create the **NDR ticket**.

If an international order was shipped or picked up by the courier, do we need to send an email before creating NDR/refund?​
✅ Whenever a customer requests for cancellation and the order status is **Packed**, **Shipped**, or **Picked up by carrier**, you must create the **NDR ticket immediately** — at the same contact time.

❌ **Do not wait** for the cancel confirmation from the shipping company before creating the NDR ticket. The **Refund Team** will follow up and await the cancel confirmation.

✅ You must continue to **send an email** to the **shipping company / logistics / warehouse** based on the case to inform them of the cancellation request.

**If the order is still in the warehouse (Packed, or Shipped but not yet received by the shipping the company):**

- Send the cancellation email to the **warehouse** and **CC the shipping company**.

How long does it take to refund an NDR order?​
Refund timing depends on **order type** + **refund method**, and starts **after the shipment has been returned**.

### **International Orders**

- **Bank / Tabby / Tamara:** **5–7 working days** after the shipment is returned
- **Store Credit (SC):** **Within 48 hours** after the shipment is returned

### **Local Orders**

- **Bank / Tabby / Tamara:** **3–5 working days** after the shipment is returned
- **Store Credit (SC):** **Within 48 hours** after the shipment is returned

title: Console Tab Training Guide
content:
Console Tab Training Guide
Sprinklr

# Console Tab Training Guide

Sprinklr · Case Management · Omni-Channel Interactions · Macros & CRM Data

1
Case Details & Layout
2
Customer 360
3
Macros & Case Resolution

## Overview of the Case Interface

The Sprinklr case interface is the central workspace for handling customer interactions. Every support agent must be familiar with this layout to navigate, respond to, and escalate cases efficiently. The screenshot below shows a live Arabic-language chat from **Houda Saeed** on Case #51154.

(image)
🔍 Click to zoom
Image 1 — Case #51154 · Full Interface
💡 Key insight:
The case interface is split into three panes —
Chat Conversation
(left),
Case Details
(centre), and
Case Collaboration / Activity
(right). Always check all three panes before responding.

### Key Fields at a Glance

Case Number
51154
Creation Time
Feb 14, 2026 · 11:55 AM
Priority
High
Case Type
Enquiry
Status
Internal Hold
Language
Arabic 🇸🇦
Channel
Sprinklr Live Chat
Contact Reason
Complaint – Wrong item (Exchange)

### Understanding the Chat Pane

- ①

            Customer Messages (Left, white bubbles)

              Messages sent by **Houda Saeed** (marked "H") appear on the left in white. The customer complained about a wrong item and requested an exchange or refund, writing in Arabic. Always read the full thread before replying to understand the full context.
- ②

            Agent / Bot Responses (Right, blue/gold bubbles)

              Responses from Sprinklr's system or agents appear on the right in blue. The bot acknowledged the issue, escalated to the specialist team, and provided a standard closing message with contact details (**+965 22263400** and the support portal link).
- ③

            System Events (Center, grey text)

              Events like *"Case unassigned from Tasnim Mohamed"* are logged automatically. These audit entries help track case handoffs and are important when reviewing resolution timelines.
- ④

            Smart Responses & Type Here Box

              At the bottom, agents can type custom replies or use **Smart Responses**. The **Send** button sends via the current channel (Boutiqaat Live Chat).

### Case Activity & Collaboration Panel

(image)
🔍 Click to zoom
Image 6 — Case Collaboration & @Mentions
- ①

            Case Activity Log

              Every macro applied, status change, queue transfer, and contact reason update is recorded here with a timestamp and the agent's name. In this case, **Tasnim Mohamed** applied the **Internal Hold** macro at 12:23 PM, triggering a department change to *Content* and an *External Email Escalation* action.
- ②

            @Mention a Collaborator

              Use the collaboration note field at the bottom of the right panel to **@mention** a team member (e.g. *@Malik* → *Malik Salfiti*). This sends an internal notification without the customer seeing it. Useful for escalating to supervisors or specialists.
- ③

            Canned Responses

              The right panel also shows **Canned Responses** — pre-written templates for common scenarios. There are separate sets for *Recent*, *Email*, and other channels. Select a template to auto-fill the reply box, then personalise as needed (Within the QA set scripts policy).
- ④

            Response SLA Tracking

              The Moderation User entries confirm **Response SLA Attached** and **Response SLA MET**. Always aim to resolve within the SLA window to keep these statuses green.

## Top Navigation Bar Actions

The toolbar at the top-right of every case provides the primary actions an agent will use. Understand each button's purpose before handling a case.

(image)
🔍 Click to zoom
Image 5 — Order Details & Case Collaboration
- ①

            View Case Details
            Opens the full case details page showing all fields, queues, SLAs, and history in a dedicated view.
- ②

            Apply Case Macro
            Opens the macro selector to apply preset workflows such as *Internal Hold*, *Resolved*, or *Awaiting Response*. Covered in detail in Tab 3.
- ③

            Get CRM Data
            Fetches the customer's profile from the CRM, including email, phone number, city, and linked orders. Covered in detail in Tab 2.
- ④

            Get Order Data (App Order ID)

              Once CRM data is loaded, enter an **App Order ID** (e.g. *KW3619614384056415*) and click **Get Order Data** to pull specific order details. Leave the field blank to retrieve all orders for that customer.

## Fetching Customer CRM Data

CRM data is pulled directly from CRM's backend into the Sprinklr interface. This gives agents a 360° view of the customer without switching systems. Follow these steps every time you handle a new case.

(image)
🔍 Click to zoom
Image 2 — CRM Fetch · Customer Details
(image)
🔍 Click to zoom
Image 3 — CRM Fetch · Profile View
⚠️ Before you start:
Always verify the customer's identity by cross-referencing the name in Sprinklr with the CRM name. If they do not match, note the discrepancy and escalate if required.

### Step-by-Step: Fetching CRM Data

- 1

            Click "Get CRM Data" in the Top Bar

              Located in the top-right corner of the case. Clicking this opens a side panel titled **Fetch CRM Data → getCustomerDetails**. The system may auto-populate the email and phone number from the customer's profile.
- 2

            Enter Email and/or Phone Number

              In the panel, confirm the pre-filled **email** (*[[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)*) and **phone** (*504900609*) are correct. Edit if needed. Both fields may be used together or individually to search the CRM.
- 3

            Click "Next" to Retrieve Customer Details

              After clicking **Next**, the system fetches the CRM record and displays a ✔ Customer Details card with all available profile fields.
- 4

            Review the Customer Details Card

              The confirmed details for this case are listed below. Verify them against what the customer has told you in the chat.

### Customer Profile — Houda Saeed

Customer Name
Houda Saeed .
Customer ID
121468
Email
[email protected]

504900609
Country
SA (Saudi Arabia)
City
Jubail
